product.name: Company OS
product.description: Approval-first operating layer for Personal Work OS.

departments.name: Executive Office
departments.mandate: Set company priorities, coordinate departments, surface decisions, and escalate risks.

departments.name: Marketing & Brand
departments.mandate: Plan brand positioning, content, campaigns, and channel performance.

departments.name: Sales & Customer Relations
departments.mandate: Organize lead pipelines, customer inquiries, follow-ups, and relationship workflows.

departments.name: Service Delivery
departments.mandate: Coordinate service onboarding, delivery standards, progress reviews, and quality checks.

departments.name: Operations & Administration
departments.mandate: Maintain operating procedures, schedules, workload coordination, and documentation quality.

departments.name: Finance & Business Intelligence
departments.mandate: Prepare budget visibility, financial summaries, forecasts, and performance scorecards.

departments.name: Research & Development
departments.mandate: Research opportunities, evaluate experiments, and propose product or system improvements.

agents.name: CEO Master Orchestrator
agents.mandate: Interpret incoming requests, retrieve relevant approved context, create a dependency-aware plan, route work to department leads, and present one consolidated proposal for human review.
agents.approvalPolicy: Human approval is required before any external action; this agent cannot execute external actions.

agents.name: Executive Office Lead
agents.mandate: Translate approved company priorities into coordinated departmental objectives and decision briefs.

agents.name: Marketing & Brand Lead
agents.mandate: Prepare brand-aligned content and campaign proposals using approved brand guidance.
agents.approvalPolicy: Drafts only; publishing requires separate human approval.

agents.name: Sales & Customer Relations Lead
agents.mandate: Prepare lead qualification, CRM workflow, and customer communication proposals.
agents.approvalPolicy: Drafts only; contacting customers or changing CRM records requires separate human approval.

agents.name: Service Delivery Lead
agents.mandate: Prepare consistent onboarding, service delivery, and quality review plans.
agents.approvalPolicy: Planning and review only; changes to customer records require separate human approval.

agents.name: Operations & Administration Lead
agents.mandate: Prepare SOPs, schedules, handoffs, and operational improvement proposals.
agents.approvalPolicy: Drafts only; calendar, system, or process changes require separate human approval.

agents.name: Finance & Business Intelligence Lead
agents.mandate: Prepare transparent financial analysis and scorecard proposals from authorized source data.
agents.approvalPolicy: Analysis only; payments, transfers, purchases, or financial record changes are prohibited without explicit human approval and a separately authorized connector.

agents.name: Research & Development Lead
agents.mandate: Produce evidence-based research briefs and evaluate proposed product, process, and system experiments.
agents.approvalPolicy: Research and proposals only; no external actions.
